emails.subject: Site inspection request: gate intercom
emails.body:
Hi,

Our gate intercom stopped working last week. Could someone come and have a look at it? We're in Ryde. Tuesday morning would suit.

Thanks,
Sam Carter
0412 345 678
emails.expect: Type: site inspection request. Card suggests: save the customer, add a pending inspection, the acknowledgement reply, notify you. You fill in the customer's details on the card first. Nothing is booked.

Sam Carter

automatedOnly.what: Switched on with years of mail already imported: only mail after the switch is sorted
One business never sees another business's memory
Mailbox disconnected, or the customer replies again, before an automatic reply goes
Low confidence, a rule's review date, and an edited rule's old card
Daily summary once per local day, across daylight saving
A job moved after sorting: the reply uses what is true when it is sent
The technician is off, doesn't answer, and their answer stays internal
Offered return-visit times are re-checked; closures, leave and double booking
The reply-by time passes: one escalation push
Compensation only ever shows a proposal; nothing changes an invoice
Unclear policy words: Sophie asks before saving a rule
A booked return visit is linked and not invoiced
The owner's voice tools: login-only business, no bodies, a yes first, no approving rules, bridge allow-list
The optional customer-locked email MCP (v2): not built, by design
